description:
Build a production-ready SaaS landing page for a fictional AI startup called "Lumina AI".

Requirements:
- Use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript only.
- Create separate index.html, styles.css, and script.js files.
- Design a premium, modern interface with polished typography, subtle animations, and excellent visual hierarchy.
- Include a hero section, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, contact form, and footer.
- Implement dark/light mode with smooth transitions.
- Make the site fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
- Ensure accessibility using semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, and proper contrast.
- Optimize performance by minimizing unnecessary JavaScript, lazy-loading where appropriate, and using efficient CSS.
- Verify that every button, link, animation, and form behaves correctly.
- Produce clean, maintainable, production-quality code with clear organization.

Expected behavior:
- Create a complete execution plan before coding.
- Execute each stage sequentially.
- Run verification after every major stage.
- Automatically repair any detected issues before continuing.
- Use project memory to avoid duplicate work.
- Create timeline checkpoints throughout execution.
- Generate diagnostics for every stage.
- Complete only after the reviewer approves the final result and all verification checks pass.
